message.content:
This is a set of Palo Santo sticks, a clip, and a bag, so I considered classification as a retail set under GRI 3(b), with the sticks giving the essential character. Palo Santo sticks burned for their aroma are "incense" under heading 3307, which covers agarbatti and other odoriferous preparations that operate by burning. Subheading 3307.41 covers "agarbatti and other odoriferous preparations which operate by burning." The 10-digit statistical suffix is 3307.41.0000.

Wood sticks that are burned for scent are treated in CBP rulings as 3307.41.

The remaining question is whether the unprepared wood is excluded from 3307. CBP rulings on Palo Santo sticks have classified them in 3307.41.0000, the "Other" subheading for odoriferous preparations that operate by burning. I rely on that.
